name: psai
description: AI for PS v2 - Photoshop UXP AI workbench (plugin + local helper)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @psai/shared && npm run build -w @psai/helper && npm run build -w @psai/plugin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @psai/shared && npm run typecheck -w @psai/helper && npm run typecheck -w @psai/plugin
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run validate
scripts.workflows:author: node tools/author-builtin-workflows.mjs
